exposure: parental testing via Sanger DNA sequencing
outcome: reclassification of variants of uncertain significance (VUS)
cohort: A cohort of 176 Spanish pediatric patients aged 9 months to 16 years with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), including intellectual disability (ID), global developmental delay (GDD), and/or autism spectrum disorder (ASD).
finding: Whole exome sequencing (WES) in pediatric patients with NDDs showed a diagnostic yield of 12.5% for proband-only testing, which increased to 17.1% after including parental testing.
cross-section timing: Recruitment and data collection occurred from January 2019 to January 2023.
